name: Post radar
description: Social posts worth answering, found for you. Your agent searches LinkedIn for people asking about what you do, skips what you have already seen, and queues each find with why it matters, a drafted comment and who should post it. You post the comment yourself: nothing goes out on its own.

deploy.subtitle: Your agent watches LinkedIn for people asking about what you do, and hands you each one with a comment ready to paste.

prompts.label: In a sentence or two, what does your company do?
prompts.placeholder: We help brands sell on Amazon, Bol and Zalando.

prompts.label: What should it look for? One search per line, in a few words.
prompts.placeholder:
bol.com specialist
Amazon expert gezocht
marketplace agency

prompts.label: Who comments for you? Your company page and each person, one per line.
